title: Dust Valley Ultra
description: Mid-to-big fast desert Ultra 4 park: sandy race loop with whoops, a valley speed cut, southern jump line, and technical rock trails off to the sides.
features: Fast desert loop, whoops field, valley cut, jump/tabletops, side rock trails, pits staging
suitablefor: Ultra 4, desert racing, freestyle jumping, light rock crawling
roads: Packed desert race corridor with dirt berms; no paved highway network

spawnPoints.description: Flat staging pad at the southwest corner. Default Ultra 4 start.
Roll into the west whoops field on the main desert loop.
North valley speed section — keep it straight and committed.
South tabletop / jump line for big Ultra 4 hits.
Technical rock trail off the east side of the desert loop.
Northwest rocky climb and shelf trail.
